scope: Test-helper-only role invocation correction; production runtime and installed artifacts unchanged.
cause: Production deliberately sets argv[0] to agentmux- plus the verified role ID. The native fixture previously required argv[0] to equal the executable path; launcher post-proof association repeated that mismatch.
review: Main read the complete seven-file correction against the failed-run snapshot. Independent reviewers found no alias-fix blocker. The private alias derives only from a verified assembly member ID, actual native executable path/digest/lineage and watches stay independently bound, both expected-image copies retain the alias, and LiteralArgs returns a defensive copy matching admitted argv. Cooperative path-argv mode stays private; exported PinDirectRoles requires exact runtime role aliases. Wrong aliases, native paths and missing/changed/extra argument tails remain refusals.
liveProofLimit: Live retains its existing identity/event contract. This correction does not add fresh argv attestation or protection against in-process argv-memory mutation. Initial and post-watch argument checks remain exact; observed re-execution invalidates the watch/version-bound identity.
mainExecutionReview: Main independently parsed all named raw passes, recomputed both stdout hashes, checked empty stderr/no fail or skip events, joined original waits/readers and matching before/after pins. Independent peer review checked all 346 snapshot entries and the tool/helper bindings. All checks ran under race detection on SDK26.5.
limitations: Actual installed cold admission remains a separate rerun. Cooperative identity tests alone cannot prove the production role alias path. These are frozen dirty-snapshot prequalification results, not a clean committed-candidate gate.
